chunks: And you, O Adam, live in the Garden, you and your spouse, and eat from wherever you wish, but do not approach this tree, lest you become among the unjust.

key_terms.الظَّالِمِينَ: The unjust (those who transgress divine limits)

ai.seo_question: What was the specific prohibition given to Adam and Eve in Paradise according to Surah Al-A'raf?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse establishes the primordial state of human innocence and free will, where the prohibition serves not as a test of obedience but as a boundary to prevent arrogance. The term 'al-Zalimin' (the unjust) implies that transgressing this divine limit constitutes self-harm and a deviation from the natural order of servitude to God.
